style: Friendly flat vector illustration in deep pine teal (#12303a), sunny yellow (#ffcf56) with small touches of spring green, autumn orange and winter blue, rounded shapes, no text.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a plain smooth engine cover (no emblem, no badge); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: A cosy repair shop interior: a car on a lift, a rack holding four sets of wheels (winter and summer tires), a tool chest, and a row of windows each showing a different season outside (spring blossom, summer sun, autumn leaves, winter snow). Flat vector, DARK pine teal overall, sunny yellow highlights. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
